about: Reviewed voice phrase bank (design 1.8, R2.2). Every phrase is a complete sentence with NO factual assertion about the product, its maker, ingredients, origin, quality or performance, and carries no digit, number word or currency. The model may only pick IDs. A phrase applies to the kinds listed and, when categories or categories_except is present, only to those shelf categories. Only the story_close bank has a default phrase: the deterministic DESCRIPTION fallback uses no phrase at all (see copy-templates.json defaults), because two listings that fall back to the same bank phrases would repeat each other word for word and fail the no-copying gate. Every phrase is at most 7 words, and no phrase run may repeat a span of 8 or more words from any catalog description.
